senses.gloss: (preced.) [to diminish, cmp. נָכָה,] to smite, wound.—
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 7:20">Targ. Ex. VII, 20</cite>. Targ. II Esth. II, 21 <he>יִמְחֵיה חויא</he> the serpent will bite him; a. v. fr.—Part. <cite ref="M00860"><he>מָחֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00810"><he>מַחְיָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>מַחְיִין</he>, <he>מַחְיָין</he>. Ib. XXI, 19 (Y. <cite ref="M00863"><he>מְחַיָּיא</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 10:15">Targ. Is. X, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:15">Targ. Y. Gen. III, 15</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. pl. <he>מְחָן</he> (<he>מָחָן</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 53:4">Targ. Is. LIII, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21a:5">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מָחִית לינוקא לא תִימְחֵי וכ׳</he> when thou strikest a child, thou must strike it only with a shoe-strap.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:13">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>דהוה מָחֵי לבנו גדול</he> was striking a grown up son.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:2">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, a. e. <he>אין אמרת מְחֵי מָחֵינָא</he> as soon as thou sayest, ‘strike’, I shall strike.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>דמחי לאיתתא וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when a person struck his neighbor’s wife, and she miscarried &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M00950"><he>מַחֲתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 11:15">Targ. II Sam. XI, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 7:9">Targ. Esth. VII, 9</cite> <he>וזקיף יִתְמְחִי עלוהי</he> (<cite ref="Ezra 6:11">Ezra VI, 11</cite>) and hanging thereon he shall be flogged (to death).
